resolution.rationale: Upstream v0.88.0 changes src/acp-agent.ts only to drop late task_* frames from earlier task runs (SDK 0.3.292+ run_id) and to refresh comments about task lineage and permission attribution. It does not touch initialize metadata, goal publication, or the goal extension, and upstream PR #1245 remains unmerged, so non-AIR goal negotiation is still absent upstream. The patch replays cleanly and unchanged on v0.88.0.

Upstream v0.88.0 adds isLateTaskRun filtering before the task_progress, task_started, task_notification and task_updated dispatch into AsyncTaskRuntime, and edits only comments in src/async-tasks.ts. The filter runs before the runtime regardless of client type, so provider-neutral opt-in clients receive the same late-run protection as AIR clients. Capability negotiation, top-level async-tasks advertisement, the shared control method and the AIR-only Bash backgrounded marker are untouched upstream. The v0.87 replacement commit replays cleanly and unchanged.
